prompt: A car accelerates uniformly from $4.0\ \text{m s}^{-1}$ to $10.0\ \text{m s}^{-1}$ in $3.0\ \text{s}$. What is the displacement of the car in this time?
markscheme: **C.** For uniform acceleration the average velocity is $\tfrac{4.0 + 10.0}{2} = 7.0\ \text{m s}^{-1}$, so $s = 7.0 \times 3.0 = 21\ \text{m}$.
